Usage, scope & sources

Use SignVoice AI for learning and personal isolated-sign practice. It is not a certified interpreter and does not translate unrestricted continuous signing.

Learning coverage

The World languages directory lists 83 language profiles and 87 lexical resource records from Universität Hamburg’s Sign Language Dataset Compendium v1.5.0. It is not a complete inventory of world sign languages. Country associations help discovery, and do not say that every person in a country uses one language. National, regional and village sign languages can differ.

Video resources

Provider videos remain at their source. Availability, registration and usage rights vary. A public video is not automatically licensed for copying, commercial use, model training or embedding. SpreadTheSign requires explicit permission for using its videos and data. Lifeprint lessons open at source. Resource cards provide access and rights links. Add personal clips only when you have the necessary permission and consent.

Camera scope

ASL has one pretrained “I love you” starter handshape. All other supported language profiles require your real recordings and a background class. Personal hand-landmark matching is a limited heuristic; facial expressions, body posture and sign-language grammar are not represented. A learning video does not become a trained camera model.

Typed practice

ASL/ISL use the bundled vocabulary indexes. Other languages use imported verified per-sign references and your personal entries. Words without an indexed sign remain marked missing. Only ASL has a bundled fingerspelling chart. No substitute signs or sentence translations are invented.

Attribution

The original ASL/ISL catalogs retain their source attribution. MediaPipe code and model notices are in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the repository. The ASL alphabet chart by Darren Stone / Dancor is public domain.

Feedback

Report broken links or incorrect source mappings through the project issue tracker ↗. Fluent-signer review is needed before relying on signs or model results.
